facts.fact: Hong Jin is male, yet powders his face white and puts something on his lips (makeup)
facts.quote: 얼굴에 하얗게 분을 칠하고 입술에 뭘 발라도 그 사실은 달라지지 않는다.

facts.fact: Looks about ten years older than the youthful, androgynous intruder
facts.quote: 홍진과 비교했을 때 십 년은 어려 보이는 외모

facts.fact: Wears navy (군청색) garments embroidered with ornate patterns
facts.quote: 화려한 문양이 수 놓인 군청색 의복을 가다듬은 홍진은

ranges.description: Hong Jin is a man who looks mature, about a decade older than a youthful, androgynous person. His face is powdered white and his lips are tinted with makeup. He wears navy garments embroidered with ornate patterns. Tags: male, mature appearance, white powdered face, tinted lips, navy garments, ornate embroidery
